hero.title: Millbrook
hero.subline: A leafy, walkable pocket of Toronto, four minutes from the subway.

summary: Millbrook Commons is a walkable Toronto neighbourhood with a Walk Score of 94. Maison Aster is 4 minutes from Millbrook Station and 15 minutes from downtown by subway.

numbers.label: (By the numbers)
numbers.heading: Independent cafés, a weekend market and one of the city’s best ravine trails, all within a ten-minute walk.

items.heading: Coffee, downstairs
items.body: Little Aster Coffee opens at 7am on the building’s retail level. The Commons market runs every Saturday, three minutes away.

items.heading: Downtown in fifteen
items.body: Millbrook Station is a four-minute walk. Waterfront parks, the financial district and the arena are a short ride away.
